display.summary: Configurable multi-strip ribbons, name-based relation lookups, managed image/font workflows, and faster request-level rendering.
highlights: Ribbon lists support configurable primary, child, and axis strips with parent-scoped discovery and separate pre-defined/admin controls.
DluxLookupField provides scoped name search, optional create-on-save, typo confirmation, and Arabic spelling normalization.
Asset Manager separates Images and Fonts, supports immediate setup-safe uploads, inline image naming, and font inventory details.
Request-level settings, language, and scope caches reduce repeated list-page work; translated table fields render automatically.
